title: Jinn PR Review
description: Reviews one queued Jinn pull request with two independent models and functional QA, then merges, returns it for fixes, or rejects the approach through one bounded adjudicator.

config.prompt:
SELECT PHASE — reconcile main safely and select one reviewable PR. Do not review code yet.

Work in the Jinn repository at `~/Projects/jinn`. Run `git fetch origin`, then inspect `git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...main`. The first number is how far local `main` is behind; the second is how far it is ahead.

- If local `main` is ahead and not behind (behind=0, ahead>0), fast-forward `origin/main` with `git push origin main:main`.
- If it is equal (behind=0, ahead=0), do not push.
- If local `main` is behind at all, do not push and decline this run with `found: no`; report the divergence.
- Never force-push. Never create a merge commit on `main`. Never use `git pull` without `--ff-only`.

List open PRs whose head branch starts with `simplify/` or `build/`, oldest first. Select exactly one that is mergeable, has a traceable originating Todo, and has green required CI. If a failed job looks flaky, re-run that red job once and wait for it; skip the PR if it stays red. Do not select a draft or a PR already carrying an active review marker.

When no candidate qualifies, emit `found: no` and concise evidence. When one qualifies, add a PR comment marking the review run, then emit `found: yes` and the PR, branch, Todo, and head details. Do not merge, edit a branch, or change Todo status.

## Production safety — absolute
- NEVER use port 7777 or touch `~/.jinn`.
- NEVER start or run a gateway without BOTH an explicit throwaway `JINN_HOME` and an explicit non-production port. Port 7788 is also forbidden.
- Before starting a throwaway daemon, inspect its config and confirm its port is neither 7777 nor 7788.
- NEVER kill a process you did not start.
- The public repository must stay generic: no real names, project or client names, emails, keys, Slack IDs, or personal absolute paths.

found.description: Exactly `yes` when one PR was selected; otherwise `no`.

prNumber.description: Selected pull request number. Omit when found is no.

prUrl.description: Selected pull request URL. Omit when found is no.

branch.description: Selected pull request head branch. Omit when found is no.

todoId.description: Originating Todo ID. Omit when found is no.

baseHead.description: Full origin/main SHA reviewed. Omit when found is no.

head.description: Full pull request head SHA. Omit when found is no.

checksStatus.description: CI state used for selection or the reason no candidate qualified.

config.prompt:
INDEPENDENT REVIEW — Opus. You are one of two reviewers. Do not read, request, predict, or defer to the other review. Do not decide whether the PR merges.

Review PR {{ node.select.fields.prNumber }} at {{ node.select.fields.prUrl }} from base {{ node.select.fields.baseHead }} through head {{ node.select.fields.head }}. Originating Todo: {{ node.select.fields.todoId }}.

Read the Todo, plan, diff, changed tests, and the shared Jinn taste rules. Review only the stated acceptance criteria and changed lines. Classify findings as Blocker, Major, or Minor using the taste rubric, and attach the required concrete evidence to each. Run a focused command when a claimed failure can be reproduced cheaply.

Return findings and counts only. Do not emit a merge/reject recommendation, do not modify code or external state, and do not declare a verdict. Speculative inputs, unmeasured performance, untouched-code refactors, coverage beyond changed lines, style preference, and hypothetical future callers are out of scope.

commands.description: Focused commands run with their real output, or `none`.

summary.description: One-sentence independent review summary without a recommendation.

config.prompt:
FUNCTIONAL QA — test the selected PR independently of code review. Do not decide whether it merges.

PR {{ node.select.fields.prNumber }} at {{ node.select.fields.prUrl }}. Compare base {{ node.select.fields.baseHead }} through head {{ node.select.fields.head }} for Todo {{ node.select.fields.todoId }}.

Read the acceptance criteria and changed surfaces. Run the relevant focused tests and the repo gates. If the change is user-visible, use the `jinn-sandbox` workflow with an explicit throwaway home and safe non-production port, then smoke-test only the affected breakpoints and clean it up. Never use production or a general dev server.

Return `qaStatus: pass` only when the requested functionality works and required checks are green. Otherwise return `qaStatus: fail` with a reproducible command or observation. Do not modify the PR, branch, Todo, or workflow state.

## Production safety — absolute
- NEVER use port 7777 or touch `~/.jinn`.
- NEVER start or run a gateway without BOTH an explicit throwaway `JINN_HOME` and an explicit non-production port. Port 7788 is also forbidden.
- Before starting a throwaway daemon, inspect its config and confirm its port is neither 7777 nor 7788.
- NEVER kill a process you did not start.

checks.description: Commands and functional checks run with real results.

summary.description: One-sentence QA result without a merge recommendation.

survivingBlockers.description: Number of independently supported Blockers after adjudication.

majors.description: Number of supported Major findings to preserve as follow-ups.

minors.description: Number of Minor findings after demotions.

findings.description: Surviving Blockers with reproduction evidence, or `none`.

followUps.description: Majors and worthwhile Minors for follow-up, or `none`.

config.prompt:
MERGE — land the adjudicated PR and close its originating Todo.

PR {{ node.select.fields.prNumber }} at {{ node.select.fields.prUrl }}, branch {{ node.select.fields.branch }}, Todo {{ node.select.fields.todoId }}. Adjudication: {{ node.adjudicate.fields.summary }}. Follow-ups: {{ node.adjudicate.fields.followUps }}.

Confirm the head is still {{ node.select.fields.head }}, required CI is still green, and GitHub reports the PR mergeable. If any has changed, stop and escalate instead of merging stale evidence. Create one follow-up Todo for each supported Major before closing the originating Todo.

Squash-merge the PR and delete its remote branch. Fast-forward local `main` from `origin/main` with `--ff-only`; never create a merge commit on `main` and never force-push. Move the originating Todo to `done` with the PR URL and merge commit in the note. Remove the active review marker.

Do not merge when the re-check is red, stale, or unmergeable.

FIX — return bounded findings to the producer. Do not edit code.

PR {{ node.select.fields.prNumber }} at {{ node.select.fields.prUrl }} for Todo {{ node.select.fields.todoId }}. Surviving Blockers: {{ node.adjudicate.fields.findings }}. Reproduction evidence: {{ node.adjudicate.fields.evidence }}.

Post the complete surviving findings and reproduction evidence as a comment on the PR. Post the same findings and PR URL as a comment on the originating Todo. Then call `update_work_item` for Todo {{ node.select.fields.todoId }} with status `executing`, so its producing workflow can repair the existing branch instead of opening another PR. Remove the active review marker.

Do not close the PR, create a replacement Todo, modify the branch, or broaden the findings beyond adjudication.

summary.description: One-sentence handback result confirming both comments and Todo status.

config.prompt:
REJECT — close an approach that should not be iterated. Do not edit code.

PR {{ node.select.fields.prNumber }} at {{ node.select.fields.prUrl }} for Todo {{ node.select.fields.todoId }}. Surviving Blockers: {{ node.adjudicate.fields.findings }}. Evidence: {{ node.adjudicate.fields.evidence }}.

Post one concise PR comment explaining why the approach is wrong, close the PR without merging, and remove the active review marker. Post the same explanation to the originating Todo and move it to `escalated` with the single decision needed before replacement work begins. Do not open a replacement PR or silently retry the rejected design.

config.message: No eligible, mergeable, CI-green PR was ready for review.
The reviewed PR was squash-merged and its Todo closed.
Bounded findings were posted and the originating Todo returned to executing.
The PR approach was rejected and its Todo escalated.
